نَخْلَةٌ سَنْهَآءُ (assumed tropical:) A palm-tree that bears one year and not another: (S, K:) or a palm-tree affected by a year of drought. (S.) And سَنَةٌ سَنْهَآءُ A year in which is no herbage nor rain. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also سَنَةٌ, last sentence but one.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
